data.one_liner: Generate Dart serializers and client helpers from GraphQL queries and schemas.
data.what_it_does: It reads GraphQL schema and document files to generate strongly typed Dart classes, serializers, and query/mutation helper methods. It supports optional integration with graphql and graphql_flutter clients.
use_when: You are using GraphQL in a Dart or Flutter project and want strongly typed models
You want helper extensions and methods for graphql or graphql_flutter clients
You use fragments and inline fragments extensively in your GraphQL queries
avoid_when: You prefer manual parsing and plain JSON maps over code generation
You are working with REST, gRPC, or WebSockets instead of GraphQL
strengths: Generates strong-typed classes for queries, mutations, and fragments
Supports custom scalars and custom enum transformations
Provides optional generated client extensions and cache manipulation helpers
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation setup
Does not fetch your schema automatically
data.setup_notes: Add graphql_codegen and build_runner to dev dependencies, configure build.yaml options if needed, and run `dart run build_runner build`.
